privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters. This policy explains what data I collect and how I use it.
privacy.analyticsContent: This website uses Cloudflare Web Analytics and Umami - both privacy-focused analytics tools. Neither uses cookies, neither collects personal data, and both only provide aggregated statistics. No individual visitor tracking occurs.
privacy.contactFormContent: When you submit the contact form, I collect your name, email address, and message. This data is processed by Web3Forms and used solely to respond to your inquiry. I do not share this information with third parties.
privacy.dataRetentionContent: Contact form submissions are retained only as long as necessary to respond to your inquiry and maintain correspondence records.
privacy.thirdPartiesContent: I do not sell, trade, or share your personal information with third parties. The only external services used are Cloudflare Web Analytics, Umami (analytics), and Web3Forms (contact form processing).
